common.comingSoon: This page is built in a later step.
common.name: Name

users.title: People
users.body: Who can sign in to this workspace, and with which role.
users.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Share it securely; they can change it after signing in.
users.deleteBody: Remove {{email}} from this workspace? Their sessions end and the email is freed.
users.roleHint: Roles decide what the server allows. The UI follows it; it does not grant it.

assets.title: Assets
assets.body: Every monitored asset, its template, and the devices reporting for it.
assets.empty: No assets yet. Create one from a template to start.
assets.name: Asset name
assets.templateHint: The template fixes the channels and their units; it cannot change later.
assets.archiveBody: Archive {{name}}? It disappears from the list; its history stays on the server.

devices.title: Devices
devices.body: Each device carries one token. The token is shown once, at mint or reissue.
devices.empty: No devices on this asset yet.
devices.name: Device name
devices.tokenBody: The server stores only its hash. This is the only time you will see it.
devices.tokenWarning: If you lose it, reissue — the old token stops working immediately.
devices.reissueBody: Reissue {{name}}'s token? The old token dies immediately and the device must be reconfigured.
devices.revokeBody: Revoke {{name}}? It stops publishing permanently; to report again, add a new device.

rules.title: Rules
rules.body: Range rules fire when a reading leaves its limits; the offline guard fires when the device goes silent.
rules.thresholdHint: A rule fires when its channel stays outside the range for the duration below, then waits out the cooldown.
rules.deleteBody: Delete this threshold rule? Alerts it opened stay in the audit trail.
rules.offlineBody: Fires when the device goes silent: no reading arrives for the minutes below. Every device is born with it; tune it — it cannot be created or deleted.
rules.quietLater: Quiet hours are added after the rule exists, on its edit screen.
rules.quietHint: Stored and judged in UTC; the preview shows your local time. Up to 20 windows; overlaps are refused by the server.
rules.noFreeChannel: Every numeric channel already has a range rule — edit it above instead of adding a second one.
rules.noFreeChannelBody: This device has no numeric channel without a range rule: the template's presets seeded one for every channel that has limits (a fridge's 2–8 °C temperature, for example). Tune those rules in the table above. To add a new rule, use a device from a template that leaves a numeric channel without limits — the Water Tank's Flow, for example.
rules.noNumericChannel: This device’s template has no numeric channels, so no range rule can be created here.
rules.noTemplateContext: This page arrived without its device’s template, so it cannot know the channels. Open it from the device list — the device row carries the template.

locale.persistFailed: The language changed on this device, but we could not save it to your account.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Sign in to your workspace.
auth.heroBody: Nabd watches your cold-chain assets and raises the alert the moment a reading crosses its limit.
auth.feature2: Alerts the moment a limit is crossed
auth.sessionNote: Your session stays in this browser tab.
auth.tenantDisabled: This workspace is disabled. Ask the platform administrator to enable it.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again.
auth.backoff: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.

dashboard.title: Live status
dashboard.body: Every asset’s current state, derived by the server from live alerts (open or acknowledged) and last seen. The push is a hint; the snapshot is the truth.
dashboard.paused: Live updates paused — sign in again
dashboard.liveHint: Pushed from the server. A dropped connection reconnects and re-syncs.
dashboard.empty: No assets yet. Create one to see its live state.

history.title: Asset history
history.body: Readings over time. The server picks raw, hourly or daily buckets so a year never costs a million points.
history.noNumeric: This asset has no numeric channel, so there is nothing to chart.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.body: Every alert the engine raised, newest first. Open and acknowledged alerts are still problems; resolved ones are history.
alerts.empty: No alerts yet. They appear here the moment a rule fires.
alerts.showingLatest: Showing the latest {{count}} of up to {{limit}}.
alerts.quietHoursBody: This alert opened during a quiet-hours window, so nobody was notified. It is still an alert.
alerts.noEvents: No events recorded for this alert yet.
alerts.resolveBody: Resolving closes the episode. Anything you write here is kept in the history.
alerts.resolveReasonHint: Leave it blank to record this as a manual resolve. Up to 200 characters.

assets.title: Assets
assets.body: The asset list arrives in a later step.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.body: The alert feed arrives in a later step.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Account and notification settings arrive in later steps.

platform.title: Platform
platform.body: The platform console arrives in a later step.

errors.network: We could not reach the server.
errors.forbidden: Your role does not allow this action.
errors.notFound: That item no longer exists in this workspace.
errors.emailTaken: That email is already used in this workspace.
errors.slugTaken: That workspace address is already taken.
errors.lastAdmin: This is the last workspace admin. Promote someone else first.
errors.selfDelete: You cannot remove your own account.
errors.roleUnknown: That role is not assignable here.
errors.weakPassword: The password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.offlineRefused: Offline rules are seeded with the device; tune that one instead.
errors.duplicateRule: A rule for this channel and limits already exists.
errors.invalidRule: Check the rule's limits, duration and cooldown.
errors.invalidMuteWindow: A quiet window is invalid: day 0–6 and start before end, within a day.
errors.historyRange: Choose a valid range: “from” before “to”, within 366 days.
errors.historyChannel: That channel does not belong to this asset.
errors.alertReason: The reason must be 200 characters or fewer.
errors.deviceRevoked: This device is revoked. A revoked token cannot be restored — recovery is a new device.
errors.feedbackMessage: Write a message first (up to 2,000 characters).
errors.feedbackEmail: That contact email is not valid.
errors.feedbackPage: This page's address is too long to attach.
errors.rateLimited: You are sending too quickly. Try again shortly.

toast.deviceMinted: Device created — copy the token now; it is shown once.
toast.deviceReissued: New token issued — the old one no longer works.
toast.deviceRevoked: Device revoked. It cannot be restored.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.intro: Tell us what is wrong or what would help. The page you are on is attached.
feedback.contactHint: Only if you want a reply.
feedback.retryIn: Please wait {{seconds}} s before sending again.
